summary.one_liner: Qwen3-Omni is Alibaba Qwen's family of natively end-to-end multimodal models that take text, image, audio, and video input and return streaming text and speech output.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes three 30B-A3B MoE checkpoints: Instruct (thinker plus talker, audio and text out), Thinking (thinker only, text out, chain-of-thought), and Captioner (fine-tuned from Instruct for detailed, low-hallucination audio captions). It supports speech recognition, translation, music and sound analysis, OCR, grounding, video description, and audio-visual dialogue. Speech input covers 19 languages and speech output covers 10, with text in 119 languages. Inference is shown via Hugging Face Transformers with qwen-omni-utils, vLLM (plus vLLM-Omni and vLLM serve), and the DashScope API. The repo also includes a local Gradio web UI and a Docker image, and it reports benchmark results against GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Qwen variants. Voice choices for output audio are Ethan, Chelsie, and Aiden.
use_cases: Multimodal chat over images, audio, and video
Captioning or analyzing music and sound effects
Real-time voice assistant with spoken replies
Serving a multimodal model with vLLM
notable: Thinker-Talker MoE design with AuT pretraining and a multi-codebook approach aimed at low latency
Separate Instruct, Thinking, and Captioner checkpoints for different needs
Option to disable the talker to save about 10GB of GPU memory when audio output is not needed
Use-audio-in-video flag that treats a video's soundtrack as part of the input
Official Docker image with Transformers and vLLM environments pre-installed
caveats: The README says Transformers inference on MoE models can be very slow; vLLM or the DashScope API are recommended for scale or low latency
Transformers 5.2.0 or later is recommended, and FlashAttention 2 needs compatible hardware
Minimum GPU memory for BF16 ranges from about 69 GB for a 15s video to about 145 GB for a 120s video; the README's numbers are theoretical minimums
The README was truncated, so the full evaluation tables and some sections were not visible
